alternatives.note: cross-family blur alternative; MTF gaussian/lens known confusable, PSNR prefers lens by 2.35 dB under same prefix

analysis.rationale: Three-step deterministic pipeline; no noise (peeled sigma 1.24 < 2; any grid noise function is >=12.75 sigma). JPEG severity corrected to q8 (sev4) by 10.8 dB bracket over q5. Blur subtype: DT motion/glass signals were JPEG-blocking false positives; PSNR arbitration gives lens:4 (37.75) > gaussian:4 (33.79) > glass (24.87) > motion (23.35) > no-blur (22.52), with unimodal severity scan 33.42/37.75/33.14. Global: additive brightness shift sev1 (+25.5) matches mean_shift 24.9 and beats HSV shift (28.84) / gamma (22.98). Order blur->brightness->jpeg confirmed by 255-clipping match (+0.008pp vs +0.338pp). Reproduced on 4 support pairs (33.1-35.1 dB, CI 9-10/10). PSNR < 40 -> per-step UNCERTAIN (severity may be +/-1).
